text.card: A red giant 2,605 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.10 solar masses and 6.0 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,833 K at its surface.
